headline: Why Is COP31 Still Without an Agreement? Fossil Fuels Divide Countries
summary: Negotiations at the COP31 climate summit ran beyond their scheduled deadline amid disagreement over phasing out fossil fuels and financing for developing nations.
why: Climate summit outcomes shape long-term policy on fossil fuel use and climate finance, which affects energy producers and investment flows.
original_headline: ¿Por qué la COP31 sigue sin acuerdo? Los combustibles fósiles dividen a los países
